speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) seeks to advance the well-being and development of Singapore through sound and forward-looking fiscal policies.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We aim to enable an innovative and efficient Government that delivers strong outcomes and value for money for taxpayers.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We are deploying effective fiscal strategies to enable a strong recovery and to position Singapore for future growth.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to build a fair and progressive fiscal system that fosters continued social mobility and uplifts the vulnerable.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will ensure sound finances and a sustainable future for generations to come.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We also provided support to businesses such as property tax rebates and rental grants, to cushion the immediate impact and provide relief on business costs.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: This was a substantial slate of support, with more help given to those most affected by the crisis.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: But it will not be sustainable to continue this level of support indefinitely.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Beyond immediate relief, the pandemic has increased the urgency of economic transformation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We must help businesses and workers adapt and grow in an economy profoundly reshaped by COVID-19.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: To this end, we are accelerating our innovation and digitalisation push across each of our Industry Transformation Maps, growing our base of innovative enterprises, and pursuing new frontiers of growth by investing in research in areas like health and biomedical sciences, climate change, and artificial intelligence.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We are forging stronger connections to major innovation nodes and key demand markets through trade facilitation and digital economy agreements, platforms like the Networked Trade Platform and Global Innovation Alliance, and by pressing on with major investments in our port and airport.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: These will strengthen our position as a Global-Asia node of technology, innovation, and enterprise.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We are also building an adaptable and skilled workforce to take on quality jobs and to power our economic transformation, through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package and the Next Bound of SkillsFuture.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have been reviewing and enhancing policies over time to build a fair and just society.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: A strong society is our stabiliser in an ever more uncertain and volatile world.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: It has helped us to weather crises, while avoiding the social fractures seen in many other countries.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will redouble efforts to strengthen our social compact, and build a united Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF will deploy resources to maintain social mobility and opportunities for all at each stage of life.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to help those who start off with less.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: To help every worker progress throughout their working lives, we are investing significant resources to build an industry-relevant skills ecosystem that will enable Singaporeans to upgrade themselves.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to strengthen our support for low-wage workers, vulnerable seniors, and households with greater care-giving burdens.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: This continues the shifts that we have progressively made over the years to strengthen social security, through schemes like Workfare and Silver Support, and enhancements to preschool, education, and healthcare subsidies.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to support affordable and quality education, healthcare, and housing for the broad base of Singaporeans, particularly the lower- and middle-income segments.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Even as we meet our needs today, we must also build for tomorrow.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF will continue to invest in building a safe and liveable home for our families, and support our vision of a Smart Nation, to improve our quality of life for current and future generations.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to invest in our defence and domestic security to protect our interests and safeguard our way of life in an increasingly complex external environment.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will build new and stronger capabilities to defend ourselves from evolving and unconventional threats.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will strengthen our resilience against crises so that we can recover and emerge stronger.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: With our major investments in the coming years, Singaporeans will benefit from improved transport connectivity through new rail lines, and active mobility infrastructure.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will rejuvenate our housing estates, and build vibrant communities in our heartlands.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will make significant and early investments to help us mitigate and adapt to the effects of climate change.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF is committed to maintain a sound and sustainable fiscal system that will enable us to realise our long-term plans for Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Our fiscal strength has enabled us to navigate the COVID-19 crisis with confidence.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: It will also give us a competitive edge in a post-COVID-19 world that puts a premium on reliability and resilience.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have used a generation's worth of savings to combat a crisis of a generation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We must therefore ensure that our fiscal balance is put back on a stable path when the economy recovers.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: COVID-19 will give rise to new spending priorities, even as we spend more to support our families with their healthcare and pre-school needs, and keep them safe.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In parallel, revenues will come under greater pressure from slower global growth in the aftermath of COVID-19 and sharper international competition over tax revenues.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will take steps to strengthen our revenue position.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will carefully monitor the timing of such moves, including the state of the economy and our spending needs.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: At the same time, we will ensure the effective and efficient use of public resources, maintain value-for-money Government procurement, and continue to support innovation and enterprise through our policies and practices.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will need collective action at all levels of society to emerge stronger from the COVID-19 crisis.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In the longer term, our success in building a vibrant economy, an inclusive society, and a better home will increasingly hinge on strong partnerships between Government, businesses, and community.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We can achieve this through SG Together, collectively harnessing the best of our people, ideas, and energies to improve Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF will continue to support, enable, and amplify the efforts, ideas and initiatives of the business and people sectors, to build a better Singapore together.
